description: Each page as a PNG or JPEG picture. One page gives a picture; several give a ZIP of them. Up to 30 pages a call. Free, with a daily limit per account. Give the file through get_upload_link (file_id) or a public link. The result link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

dpi.description: Sharpness: 150 for the screen, 300 for print.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the PDF there.

file_url.description: Or a public https link to the PDF. A result link from another YangOpen tool works too.

pages.description: Pages, counting from 1: "1-3,5", "8-" (8 to the end) or "last". Default: every page, up to 30.

name: pdf_to_images
title: Turn PDF pages into pictures
